privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains how Kalima collects, uses, protects, and shares information when students, parents, teachers, and visitors use the Kalima website, store, e-booklets, and related services.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect account details, contact information, role information, learning activity, purchases, payment status, support messages, device and browser data, and any files or information users choose to submit through the platform.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: We use information to create and secure accounts, provide educational content, process orders and e-booklet access, support teachers and students, send service notifications, improve platform quality, and comply with legal or operational requirements.

sections.title: Payments and purchases
sections.body: Payment and order information may be processed through trusted payment, banking, or manual proof-of-payment workflows. Kalima keeps the information needed to confirm payment status, deliver access, prevent abuse, and support refunds or disputes.

sections.title: Sharing information
sections.body: We do not sell personal information. We may share limited information with service providers that help operate hosting, payments, messaging, analytics, customer support, or security, and when required by law or necessary to protect users and the platform.

sections.title: Security and access
sections.body: We use technical and administrative safeguards to protect user information. Users are responsible for keeping login details private. Some e-booklet and learning access may be linked to account, role, purchase, invite code, or device controls.

sections.title: User choices
sections.body: Users may request help updating account information, accessing purchased content, or asking privacy questions through the official contact channels available on the platform. Some records may be retained when required for security, financial, legal, or operational reasons.

sections.title: Children and education accounts
sections.body: Kalima is an education platform used by students and families. Parents, guardians, teachers, and authorized school or platform administrators may help manage student access where applicable.

sections.title: Updates to this policy
sections.body: Kalima may update this policy as services, features, legal requirements, or operational practices change. The latest version will be published on this page.

dataDeletion.title: Request Account and Data Deletion
dataDeletion.intro: Use this page to request deletion of your Kalima account and associated personal data from the platform.
dataDeletion.requestBody: Contact Kalima support from the phone number or account details connected to your account. We may ask you to verify ownership before deleting account data.
dataDeletion.stepsTitle: What to include in your request
steps: The phone number or email used for your Kalima account.
Your account role if known: student, parent, teacher, or visitor.
A clear statement that you want your account and associated data deleted.
dataDeletion.dataTitle: What happens after you request deletion
notes: Kalima will verify that the requester owns or is authorized to act for the account.
After verification, we will delete or anonymize account information that is no longer required to provide the service.
Some records may be retained when required for security, fraud prevention, payment, tax, accounting, legal, or dispute-resolution purposes.
Deleting your account may remove access to purchases, e-booklets, orders, learning records, and related platform services.
